comparisons.peer_summary: The information contained on AMD's website is not incorporated by reference in, or considered to be a part of, this report.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and AMD include standard website disclaimers stating that information contained on their websites is not incorporated by reference into the 10-K. While Intel ties this to its sustainability reports (CR Report, TCFD disclosures), AMD applies the disclaimer generally to website information, including SEC filings and governance documents. The core legal mechanism of non-incorporation by reference is shared.

comparisons.peer_topic: Access to SEC Filings and Governance Documents
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD posts links to its SEC filings, corporate governance documents, and ethics codes on its Investor Relations website at http://ir.amd.com, making them available free of charge as soon as reasonably practical after filing with the SEC. Copies can also be obtained by writing or emailing the Corporate Secretary.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and AMD provide guidance on where investors can access governance and compliance documents. Intel references its Annual Corporate Responsibility Report, Climate Policy, and 10-K Risk Factors, with a disclaimer on website info. AMD explicitly lists its SEC filings, Principles of Corporate Governance, Code of Ethics, and Board charters on its IR website, noting they are available free of charge. Both facilitate access to governance documents via their websites.

sentences.text: We describe our overall risk management processes in our proxy statement, and describe climate-related risks and opportunities in our annual Corporate Responsibility Report, the Intel Climate Change Policy, the Intel Climate Transition Action Plan, and "Risk Factors" within this Form 10-K.

On the Investor Relations pages of our website, http://ir.amd.com, we post links to our filings with the SEC, our Principles of Corporate Governance, our Code of Ethics for our executive officers, all other senior finance executives and certain representatives from legal and internal audit, including our Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer, Chief Accounting Officer and persons performing similar functions, our Worldwide Standards of Business Conduct, which applies to our Board of Directors and all of our employees, and the charters of the committees of our Board of Directors.
All of these documents and filings are available free of charge.

comparisons.peer_summary: Broadcom's website is www.broadcom.com, where investors can access free SEC filings and proxy statements, though such website information is not incorporated into the Annual Report.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Broadcom (AVGO) provide investor resources on their websites, including SEC filings, and include disclaimers that website information is not incorporated by reference. Broadcom explicitly mentions SEC filings and proxy statements on its investor center page, while Intel references its Corporate Responsibility Report and Climate disclosures. The shared element is the provision of documents via the website with a non-incorporation disclaimer.

sentences.text: We describe our overall risk management processes in our proxy statement, and describe climate-related risks and opportunities in our annual Corporate Responsibility Report, the Intel Climate Change Policy, the Intel Climate Transition Action Plan, and "Risk Factors" within this Form 10-K.

The Corporate Responsibility Report and our CDP Climate Change and Water Surveys are available on our website and are published annually. [footnote 1] [footnote 1] The contents of our website and our Corporate Responsibility Report, Climate Change Policy, Climate Transition Action Plan, and CDP Climate Change and Water Surveys are referenced for general information only and are not incorporated by reference in this Form 10-K.

At the "Investor Center" page on this website, we promptly make available free of charge the reports we file or furnish pursuant to Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (the "Exchange Act") with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC"), as well as our proxy statements.
The information posted on our website is not incorporated into this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

comparisons.peer_summary: Corporate governance guidelines, various committee charters, and the Code of Business Conduct and Ethics are available on the company's website and to shareholders upon request. Amendments or waivers to the Code of Business Conduct and Ethics will be posted on the website within four business days to satisfy Form 8-K Item 5.05 requirements.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Micron (MU) make corporate governance documents available on their websites and disclaim that website information is not incorporated by reference. Micron lists specific documents like Governance Guidelines and Code of Business Conduct, while Intel references its Corporate Responsibility Report and Climate Policy. Both companies explicitly state that the content on their websites does not form part of the 10-K.

comparisons.peer_summary: NVIDIA integrates ESG principles into its business operations, with the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee of the Board overseeing sustainability practices and assessing programs annually based on stakeholder expectations and risks.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and NVIDIA disclose board-level oversight of sustainability/ESG matters. Intel explicitly states that its Corporate Governance and Nominating Committee has board-level oversight of climate-related activities. Similarly, NVIDIA’s Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee is responsible for reviewing sustainability and corporate governance practices, with annual assessments based on stakeholder expectations. Both companies utilize a specific Board committee for this governance function.

sentences.text: For governance and strategy, we follow an integrated approach to address climate change, with multiple teams responsible for managing climate-related activities, initiatives, and policies, with senior-level management involvement and board-level oversight, including the Corporate Governance and Nominating Committee.

The Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee of our Board of Directors is responsible for reviewing and discussing with management our practices related to sustainability and corporate governance.
We assess our programs annually in consideration of stakeholder expectations, market trends, and business risks and opportunities.

comparisons.peer_summary: NVIDIA provides an overview of sustainability principles in this section and its annual Sustainability Report, accessible via its website, but explicitly states that this external information is not incorporated by reference into SEC filings.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies reference external sustainability reports available on their websites but disclaim that this external information is not incorporated by reference into their SEC filings. Intel maps its disclosure to frameworks like TCFD and GRI in its Corporate Responsibility Report, while NVIDIA provides an overview of principles and details in its annual Sustainability Report. Both explicitly state that website information, including these reports, does not form part of the 10-K.

sentences.text: We are committed to transparency around our carbon footprint and climate risk, and use the framework developed by the TCFD to inform our disclosure on climate governance, strategy, risk management, and metrics and targets.
In addition, our Corporate Responsibility Report includes a mapping of our disclosure to the TCFD, GRI, and SASB frameworks.

The Corporate Responsibility Report and our CDP Climate Change and Water Surveys are available on our website and are published annually. The following section and the Human Capital Management Section below provide an overview of our principles and practices.
More information can be found on our website and in our annual Sustainability Report.

Information contained on our website or in our annual Sustainability Report is not incorporated by reference into this or any other report we file with the Securities and Exchange Commission, or the SEC.

comparisons.peer_summary: ESG oversight is distributed among the Board's Governance Committee (policies/programs), HR and Compensation Committee (human capital/diversity), and Audit Committee (disclosure controls), while the ESG Leadership Committee guides strategy and the ESG Working Group implements directives and reports progress.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose detailed board committee structures for ESG oversight. Intel places oversight with the Corporate Governance and Nominating Committee. Qualcomm distributes oversight among multiple committees: the Governance Committee (policies/programs), HR and Compensation Committee (human capital/diversity), and Audit Committee (disclosure controls). Both describe an integrated approach with specific committee roles defined.

sentences.text: For governance and strategy, we follow an integrated approach to address climate change, with multiple teams responsible for managing climate-related activities, initiatives, and policies, with senior-level management involvement and board-level oversight, including the Corporate Governance and Nominating Committee.
The Governance Committee of our Board provides oversight on ESG matters not delegated to other Board committees, including ESG policies, programs and initiatives.

The HR and Compensation Committee of our Board provides oversight on our human capital initiatives and our workforce diversity, equity and inclusion policies, programs and initiatives, while the Audit Committee of our Board provides oversight of certain ESG disclosure controls and procedures.

comparisons.peer_summary: Qualmont encourages stockholders and stakeholders to review its Corporate Responsibility Report and Proxy Statement for detailed ESG and governance information, clarifying that website content, including these reports, is not incorporated by reference into the Annual Report.

Intel references its Corporate Responsibility Report and Climate Change Policy, while Qualcomm references its Corporate Responsibility Report and Proxy Statement. Both make clear that while stakeholders are encouraged to review these for details, they are not part of the filing itself.

sentences.text: We describe our overall risk management processes in our proxy statement, and describe climate-related risks and opportunities in our annual Corporate Responsibility Report, the Intel Climate Change Policy, the Intel Climate Transition Action Plan, and "Risk Factors" within this Form 10-K.
